mechanism: Betamethasone may increase carisoprodol metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing carisoprodol efficacy, while carisoprodol's CNS depression may be potentiated by corticosteroid effects on the nervous system.
action: Monitor for reduced muscle relaxant efficacy and increased CNS depression; consider dose adjustment of carisoprodol if needed and counsel on avoiding concurrent CNS depressants.
